verdicts.reason: The two candidates share the same flawed right cluster. The Try It button overlaps the bottom of the product circle, and 'Out now.' has been pulled away from the headline and stuck beside the button, so it reads as a stray label. All the weight sits on the right while the left is mostly empty. A's two-line headline is a sensible size and leaves a gap before the circle. B's one-line headline runs almost into the circle, which makes the layout look cramped and less intentional.
